title: ADAPT: Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing for Pull Requests
abstract: arXiv:2611.16114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern software development relies on pull requests (PRs) that introduce small, targeted code changes. Once merged, these changes should be protected by focused tests that exercise the behavior the PR introduces, yet developers often submit PRs without such tests, leaving the new behavior unguarded against future regressions. Most test generation techniques target entire software units and optimize objectives such as code coverage rather than the behavior a change introduces, and prior diff-aware approaches have had limited success in capturing it.   We propose ADAPT (Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing), a regression test generation approach that uses an autonomous coding agent to produce change-focused tests for PRs. Given a PR, the agent analyzes the diff between the base and head versions to identify the modified functions and their context, then plans and generates candidate unit tests. A dedicated fail-to-pass (F2P) verification too

translated_title: ADAPT：面向拉取请求的智能体式差异感知补丁测试
translated_abstract: 现代软件开发依赖于拉取请求（PR），它们引入小而集中的代码变更。一旦合并，这些变更应当由针对性的测试加以保护，即通过测试来验证PR所引入的行为；然而开发者提交PR时往往缺乏此类测试，导致新行为无法防范未来的回归。大多数测试生成技术面向整个软件单元，并以代码覆盖率等指标为优化目标，而非变更所引入的行为；先前的差异感知方法在捕捉变更行为方面的效果也较为有限。我们提出ADAPT（Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing，智能体式差异感知补丁测试），一种利用自主编码智能体为PR生成以变更为核心的回归测试的方法。给定一个PR，智能体分析基础版本与目标版本之间的差异，识别被修改的函数及其上下文，随后规划并生成候选单元测试。一个专门的“由失败转为通过”（F2P）验证工具……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ADAPT利用自主编码智能体分析拉取请求的代码差异，生成聚焦于变更行为的回归测试，从而保护新引入的功能免受未来代码回归的破坏。
en_tdlr: ADAPT employs an autonomous coding agent to analyze pull request diffs and generate change-focused regression tests that guard newly introduced behavior against future regressions.
